# E0389: a lens indexes a table with a value that is not a finite set of constants

A lens indexes a table by a value that is not one of a finite set of string
constants. The checker needs every possible key to show each has an entry.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				t: string
			}
		}
	}
	"1": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				u: 1 | 2
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.0->1.0": {
		_T: {a: 1, b: 2}
		v0_0: _
		v1_0: {
			u: _T[v0_0.t]
		}
	}
	"1.0->0.0": {
		v1_0: _
		v0_0: {
			t: ""
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0389]: u in the result of lens 0.0->1.0 is not total for some instance
  --> lineage.cue:23:7
   |
23 |             u: _T[v0_0.t]
   |                ^^
   |
   = note: u in the result of lens 0.0->1.0 indexes a table by v0_0.t, which may be string rather than one of a finite set of string constants; the checker needs every possible key
   = note: a lens must be total: every instance of schema 0.0 must translate to an instance of schema 1.0 (totality rule unknown-table-key)
   = help: write the mapping in a form the checker can follow, or add a lacuna where it cannot decide
```
